name: Havoc in the Highlands
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank the winds you've returned!Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.Winds guide you, Zaelriel.
narrative.requestItemsText: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 8, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

quests.name: Havoc in the Highlands
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

quests.name: To Valanaar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
